item.where: Lesson 4 vs Lesson 3, free-fall of the bucket
item.problem: Lesson 3 gives a speed of 11.0 m/s at 2 m (KE 1200 J), while Lesson 4 gives 11 m/s as the speed at the water (KE 1210 J). The same speed is attached to different energies and positions.
item.quote_a: compare the ideal fall of the bucket (KE 1600 J, v = 12.6 m/s) with the real fall (v = 11 m/s, KE 1210 J)
item.quote_b: at 2 m PE = 400 J, KE = 1200 J, v = 11.0 m/s

items.recommendation: No change; optionally add a short note in Lesson 4 that the real fall's 11 m/s is a different measurement from the ideal fall.
items.reason: Lesson 3 gives the ideal speed at 2 m (v = sqrt(2 x 10 x 6) = 11 m/s, correct for 6 m of fall), while Lesson 4 gives a measured real speed at the water (0 m) of 11 m/s, a separate situation with different energy (KE 1210 J). The same number at different positions is a coincidence, not a contradiction.
